description: Stops monitoring one competitor URL. Its historical snapshots and detected changes are deleted along with it (cascading delete) — unlike rank tracking's competitor removal, there is no separate archive kept.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

targetId.description: Monitored URL's target ID, from list_competitor_monitors or add_competitor_monitor.

name: remove_competitor_monitor
